//= and duplicate() identity are never touched by this file.

//=   official identity  the official rAthena script at the fork point, joined on
//=                      map + x + y + dir + kind + sprite
//=   phase4.12 dict     the verified NPC name dictionary the client already uses
//=   :: unique slot     the script's own unique-name slot when it is a real name
//=
//= The third argument 1 means "quiet": a map-server that does not own this NPC's
//= map is expected not to find it.
//============================================================================
